interpretation: The aggregate-depth rule, fixed before this panel was analysed, classified all five two-copy 23S loci as MULTICOPY_DEPTH and all five single-copy gyrB controls as SINGLE_COPY_COMPATIBLE, meeting the prespecified primary criteria; the 21 depth fields it reports are identical to the archived depth-only values. Graph traversal returned one context for every gyrB control and two matched contexts for four of the five 23S loci, each returned as copy number 2 under GRAPH_COUNT_OVER_DISCORDANT_DEPTH because the depth interval lies above two. At Hpfe0004 both locus ends also yielded two contexts, but the traversal met a cycle, so the count is reported as a lower bound of two rather than as an exact count. The graph acceptance criterion for 23S is therefore met in four of five loci, and all_primary_criteria_passed, which requires it, is false. Observed 23S depth ratios were 2.546-3.221. The panel informed the design of the graph method; it is a biological demonstration, not an independent performance estimate or proof of universal exact rRNA copy-number recovery.
execution_note: The five SPAdes 4.2.0 --isolate drafts (4 threads, 14 GB memory cap) were assembled from the same checksum-verified read files by the closed-genome stage of the tier calibration and reused here, since the workflow keeps an existing draft; memory_gb below therefore applied to no assembly in this run. The GFA checksums are recorded in workflow_provenance.json.
